title: 🦇 LEGO Build & Watch: The LEGO Batman Movie
description:
Calling all LEGO lovers! Bring your favorite LEGO set (or one you've been meaning to build) and join us for a cozy afternoon of building and watching The LEGO Batman Movie.
Whether you're cracking open a brand-new set or finally finishing one that's been sitting on your shelf, this is your chance to relax, create, and enjoy the movie alongside fellow LEGO fans.
Your ticket includes:
🍿 Popcorn and light snacks
🥤 Refreshments
🎬 A screening of The LEGO Batman Movie
✨ A cozy, welcoming space to build and unwind
Please bring your own LEGO set or project. We recommend choosing something you'll enjoy working on for about two hours.
Come solo or bring a friend—no building experience required, just a love of creating and a good sense of humor.

Family-Friendly: Children ages 5–12 are welcome with a Children's ticket and must be accompanied by a ticketed adult. Because of small LEGO pieces and the relaxed movie-and-build format, this event is recommended for ages 5+.
